title: Sugar Rush
blurb: Lollipops, gumdrops and a giant donut. The gentlest climb, sweet from the first shot to the last.

levels.name: Lollipop Lane
levels.intro: Break all six orange pegs. Land on the moving plate to get your ball back.

levels.name: Candy Cane Alley
levels.intro: New: multiball pegs burst two more balls into play. Break any thirty six pegs.

levels.name: Gumball Globe
levels.intro: Break the eight orange gumballs. New: green extra ball pegs give you one more ball.

levels.name: Sweet Swirl
levels.intro: Score twelve thousand points. New: double points pegs double a whole shot.

levels.name: Rock Candy
levels.intro: Collect all seven gems. New: lightning pegs light up the six nearest pegs.

levels.name: Sprinkle Cone
levels.intro: Break the eight orange pegs. New: spray pegs make your next shot fire three balls.

levels.name: Chocolate Bar
levels.intro: New: barrier bricks. Their colour and dots show the hits left. Break every brick.

levels.name: Gumdrop Hills
levels.intro: Break the eight orange pegs. New: bumpers never break and bounce your ball away fast.

levels.name: Birthday Cake
levels.intro: Light all seven candle lanterns. New: steel posts never break.

levels.name: Candy Hearts
levels.intro: Clear every peg. New: glass shatters at the first touch, and your ball flies through.

levels.name: Peppermint Twist
levels.intro: New: safety net pegs. The plate takes turns, catching and then bouncing.

levels.name: Taffy Pull
levels.intro: Light twenty pegs in one shot. New: a blast ball explodes on its first hit.

levels.name: Candy Jar
levels.intro: Collect all eight gems. New: hit a key to open the gate of the same colour.

levels.name: Fudge Fountain
levels.intro: Break the nine orange pegs. New: a fireball burns straight through pegs.

levels.name: Caramel Creek
levels.intro: Score twenty nine thousand points. New: sticky sludge pegs slow your ball right down.

levels.name: Gingerbread House
levels.intro: Clear every peg. New: a portal sends your ball to its twin, and it keeps going.

levels.name: Jawbreaker Vault
levels.intro: Break every brick. New: armour bricks only crack from blasts, fireballs and lightning.

levels.name: Giant Donut
levels.intro: Light all nine lanterns. New: some pieces move. The giant donut slowly turns.

levels.name: Cotton Candy Clouds
levels.intro: Find all seven hidden gems. New: super guide shows every bounce. Thieves steal powers.

levels.name: Candy Castle
levels.intro: Break all twelve orange pegs to take the candy castle.
